claimAdjudication.claim: A command-metadata-only push or pull request does not trigger the workflow that declares and runs the authoritative fleet metadata gate.
claimAdjudication.counterevidenceSought: Reviewed both push and pull-request path filters for broader patterns, then checked the exact local pre-push gate and its bypass semantics.

claimAdjudication.downgradeTrigger: Another mandatory CI workflow invokes the same fleet gate for every command-metadata-only change, or both path filters are expanded.

findingDetails.title: Fleet gate silently passes a non-directory --skills-dir
findingDetails.evidence: findSkillRoots suppresses enumeration errors into an empty list and run treats that list as a successful zero-root fleet; direct read-only execution against an existing spec.md returned checked=0 and exit 0.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The scoped gate has one discovery function and one run path; the scoped tests cover violations but no discovery error or zero-root fail-closed rule.

claimAdjudication.claim: The authoritative fleet metadata gate can return success without scanning roots when --skills-dir exists but cannot be enumerated as a directory.
claimAdjudication.counterevidenceSought: Checked run() for stat/readability validation and scoped tests for discovery-error or zero-root coverage; neither exists. Direct execution against an existing file reproduced exit 0.
claimAdjudication.alternativeExplanation: An intentionally empty readable directory could be valid, but does not justify accepting a regular file or suppressing enumeration errors.
claimAdjudication.downgradeTrigger: Downgrade only if every production caller independently proves a readable directory and checked=0 is an intentional monitored success.
